answers: Not much. Branch deletion frees almost nothing; a branch is a 41-byte file. Space comes back only after reflog expiry and git gc.
The uploads/tmp folder, at 31G, is the biggest clear target. Docker at 48G is the second, but it needs your go.
Access (SSH host, user, sudo), the uploads/tmp rules and safe age, which branches to keep, Docker go or no-go, a backup confirmation, and a target free-space level.
